id: Lock, Stock and Two Smoking Barrels (1998)
title: Lock, Stock and Two Smoking Barrels
tagline: Bad card game. Good fry up. Pass the brown sauce.
about: Four friends lose a rigged card game and scramble to raise half a million pounds in a week.

    Bar snacksFrom the KitchenSweetsAt the Bar
    Bar snacksSmoked mackerel pâtéSmoked mackerel blended with cream cheese and horseradish, on toasted rye with cucumberHow to make it250g smoked mackerel150g cream cheese1 tbsp horseradish1 lemon6 slices of rye bread1 Lebanese cucumberFlake the mackerel, removing the skin and bones.Blitz with the cream cheese, horseradish, lemon juice and black pepper until mostly smooth.Toast the rye.Spread on the toast and top with thin cucumber slices.Hatchet Harry's vinegar pork scratchingsPork crackling and malt vinegar. Harry's game is rigged.How to make it500g pork rind1 tbsp salt2 tbsp malt vinegar1 box sea salt flakesScore the pork rind into strips and rub well with salt.Dry uncovered in the fridge overnight.Roast on a rack at 220°C until puffed and crackling.Brush lightly with malt vinegar while hot, then toss in sea salt flakes.Tip into paper bags.From the KitchenBig Chris's pie and chipsBeef and ale pie, chips, peas. It's been emotional.How to make it1kg beef chuck, diced2 brown onions1 bunch thyme375ml English ale1 sheet puff pastry1kg potatoes2 L vegetable oil300g frozen peas30g butter1 bunch mint2 tbsp plain flourBrown the beef with the sliced onions and thyme.Add the ale and braise.Thicken with the flour, pour into a dish, cover with puff pastry and bake at 200°C.Cut the potatoes into thick chips and fry twice in the vegetable oil until golden.Cook the peas and crush with the butter and mint.Bacon's full EnglishA fry up, brown sauce. One price, ten poundHow to make itNot on tonight's cookBacon, bangers, fried eggs, beans, mushrooms, blistered tomato and fried bread crisped in the bacon fat, brown sauce on the table.Grill 8 pork sausages for 15 minutes, turning.Fry 8 rashers bacon and keep warm, then fry 4 slices of bread in the bacon fat until crisp.Fry 250g mushrooms in butter and halve 4 tomatoes and grill until blistered.Warm a tin of baked beans.Fry 4 eggs.Load onto four warm plates and put brown sauce on the table.SweetsSpotted dick and custardSteamed sponge pudding studded with currants, served with custardHow to make it100g butter250g self-raising flour75g caster sugar150g currants150ml full cream milk600ml custardRub the butter into the flour, then stir in the sugar and currants.Add the milk to a soft dough.Press into a greased basin and cover with paper and foil.Steam.Turn out and serve with hot custard.At the BarTwo smoking barrels peated whisky sourPeated Scotch, lemon, honey and egg white. Antique shotguns not included.How to make it200ml peated Scotch whisky3 lemons2 tbsp honey2 tbsp warm water4 egg whites1 bottle aromatic bitters1 bag iceMix the honey with warm water for honey syrup.Shake the whisky, lemon juice, syrup and egg white hard without ice, one drink at a time.Shake again with ice and strain into a tumbler over ice.Dot the foam with aromatic bitters.
